purpose: One concrete shared owner/clock/input/resource/commit/restart contract for grouped D0-D6 development;not a vendor ABI or completed product.

external_api_facts.authority: W3C Working Draft,30 October2026; normative design reference, not host test
external_api_facts.paraphrase: A request success can precede transaction failure; use the transaction complete event as its successful commit receipt. Durability is a user-agent hint and is not a device or power-loss test.

external_api_facts.authority: Official WeChat documentation URLs could not be opened by this turn
external_api_facts.result: non-retryable retrieval error; no content/limit/lifecycle claim inferred
external_api_facts.existing_typings_scope: Only already retained declared shapes may guide adapters; file capacity,offsets,drain and device lifecycle require explicit capability evidence.

SourceProfile.rule: All wire/layout/ABI decisions bind an admitted existing profile;legacy and current handoff are not automatically paired.

OperationContext.rule: Internal tokens are local ownership metadata and are never added to vendor packets. Deadlines,source phase timers and role/source identity remain distinct.

Outcome.rule: No result infers a vendor ACK,physical release,commit or final delivery beyond its authority.

CommitReceipt.rule: An API request success and a lost callback are not not_committed proof. After committed,late cancellation cannot change it to cancelled.

DrainReceipt.rule: Only physical drained pluszero leases allows deletion/reuse;logical close may complete while backend callbacks remain.

Lease.rule: Charge unique backing allocations/handles once. Views retain the charge;copies add charges;transfer preserves it until physical completion.

SourceContextValue.rule: Raw tuple/RID words,scratch,boxed words,aliases and callback counters keep their representation. Missing source data is never synthesized aszero or replaced by another actor.

HostCapabilityReceipt.rule: Declared,type-checked,locally-tested,device-tested and externally-accepted evidence are distinct;unavailable host paths leave the full requirement open.

ports.name: ContextOwner
required_rules: Give resource operations a single total deadline;do not extend it at each child await. Login candidate and accepted-request source timers separately restart as prescribed by LO-D02;an optional host total deadline is an explicit different policy.

Check context before asynchronous publication/commit. A source callback admitted under an InvocationLease may execute its documented tail after logical deletion;do not replace the tail with a blanket throw or immediate free.
Source source-count bytes/words,game state,local revisions,connection identity and resource leases remain separate. Every business owner declares its carry/reset/publication table.
failure_receipts: expired/cancelled prior to commit stops new publication
retired UI owner cannot receive old callbacks as a new context
inflight known effects settle into the journal even after the old UI disappears

ports.name: ClockDomains
required_rules: Do not use one clock for unsigned source-tick differences,absolute speech deadlines,wall calendar and callback counters. Preserve source wrap/signed-width behavior per rule.
Keep source repeated sampling distinct from a host single-frame tick. Background resume must declare rebase/catchup and outstanding timer decisions before input resumes.
Every timer declares whether it countssource callbacks,absolute source time,per-phase timeout or whole-operation deadline;no universal60Hz or unlimitedcatchup equivalence is assumed.
failure_receipts: missing time origin returns unavailable for an origin-dependent compatibility claim
nonmonotonic host clock is a host failure,not a silent source wall-calendar clamp

ports.name: InputAndTextFocus
required_rules: Classic and alternate bit masks remain distinct. Convert DOM/touch/Page events in adapters;source key query/clear and business eligibility stay in shared core.
Keep physical/display/actor logical coordinates separate;render and hit testing share an explicitly invertible viewport transform. Pointer cancel ends the held capture and invalidates its gesture.
Focus/composition is bound to its owner/epoch;late composition cannot write a newly focused editor. Apply source Enter/history/CR rules per target rather than a universal submit.
failure_receipts: unrepresentable text returns an explicit encoding result
background/owner loss retires stale input without undoing a previously committed business edit

ports.name: SourceValueContext
required_rules: Do not normalize113/260 preparer/runtime read order;preserve decoder-owned rawnumeric tails,byte counters,forced pair and guard ownership. The source reader and runtime effect counters are different.

For107 keep the raw two-word formatting inputs and source format/ABI;vtable52D340 and payload are not logical current/max vitals. A portable representation must retain the profile type word and actual payload origin.
RID foreign words,uninitialized fourth scratch and source aliases must carry origin/availability. Never use self words or portablezero to certify missing native context.
98 assistantFF early return and other ITM raw-cursor continuation remain source state;current discard/complete or unavailable handlers are deltas,not proof of native normal completion.
failure_receipts: missing required context leaves that original behavior open and returns needs-context
no dummy actor,syntheticACK or fake no-op completion

ports.name: SharedUpdatePump
required_rules: Separate source updates,presentation,waiting and catchup. Use one application owner for source RNG/audio maintenance/calendar;do not silently combine local boxed RNG with Math.random.
Preserve source constructor order,anonymous/registered ownership,parent deletion tails and source waits. Logical deletion flags and physical object-pool retirement are separate.
A resource/animation/signal failure is an explicit stage outcome;it cannot advance an action or round as if completion was observed.
failure_receipts: missing source RNG/seed/cadence context remains explicit
presentation/audio blocked by host remains unaccepted for that capability

ports.name: BudgetAndLease
required_rules: Validate arithmetic before allocation;charge input,scratch,decoded pixels/audio,metadata,pins and queued copies at the same root. Views share a backing allocation;copies do not.
BudgetProfile must cover the complete admitted resource manifest and actual concurrent lifetime. No unmeasured fixed32MiB limit is used to remove original resources.
When memory is insufficient,release unpinned caches or use the already specified range/chunk path. An inflight buffer remains charged until physical completion even after cancellation.
failure_receipts: capacity refusal states required/available/stage without publishing partial state
host/system peaks and owned-lease accounting require separate measurements

ports.name: StableRangeSource
required_rules: Use exact checked ranges and stable content identity. ZIP64 offsets remain lossless;converting to a host numeric offset requires exact representability and advertised domain,including positions beyond2^32.
A short read is not successful requested data. Zero-length is handled in the adapter and never forwarded to an incompatible host call.
Callback-only I/O may be logically retired without physical abortion. Keep native writer/reader buffers leased until their callback/drain authority settles.
A moved/saved temporary path gets a new validated source binding;do not assume an active descriptor survives a move. Browser Blob selection has its own immutable session identity.
failure_receipts: unsupported offset/large-file path stays an unmet full requirement
never substitute a whole-file read while claiming range/budget compliance

ports.name: SnapshotStore
required_rules: Compute content checks before the final publication transaction. Stage blocks then verify complete metadata;the final active pointer/expected revision check is one backend-authoritative publication boundary.

For IndexedDB use a single overlapping readwrite transaction for comparison and pointer update;request success alone is not commit. Report actual durability/evidence rather than power-loss guarantees.
For WeChat declare the actual writer scope and a validated journal/manifest recovery protocol. Do not infer crash-atomic publication from rename/saveFile or an in-memory mutex.
Missing/broken candidates do not overwrite the last verified active snapshot. Unknown commit results require inspection before any replayed mutation.
Persistent-required and session-only modes return distinct receipts;resource content,config/mail state and transient account/session data have different owners and schemas.
failure_receipts: quota/short-write/abort/version conflict retains previous active identity
no valid recovered commit returns needs-selection,not an empty successful resource root

ports.name: OwnerLifecycle
required_rules: Resource,window,text,decoder,renderer,audio,connection and Page/App owners declare separate retirement boundaries. A dirty inactive callback,hidden mark and physical free are not one bool.
Admitted source callbacks may continue after marking themselves/parents deleted as their rule requires;lease retirement prevents future admission without cutting an already admitted tail.
Delete old data only after relevant I/O/decoder/render/audio consumers are physically drained and all snapshot references released. A zero source count byte is not a lease proof.
failure_receipts: unknown backend completion retains leases and an explicit draining/unknown state
close user-visible state may settle before physical drain;acceptance records both

ports.name: UpdateTakeoverAndRestart
required_rules: Separate content update,application code reload and known native reference process launch. A browser reload request,patch exit or storage success alone is not the new game running.
Keep C82 Code.pat/module-directory preparation distinct from601b packagedSource. Source overwrite/copy/start failures and direct retry102 effects remain recorded;do not promise source rollback.

Portable snapshot publication follows its own declared transaction,then a nonsecret restart intent records expected content/profile/revision. Credentials and unproved handoff fields are never persisted or invented.

After committed report committed even if cancellation or restart fails;inspect an unknown publication before retry. New boot must verify its bound content/profile/revision and actual startup readiness.
Old readers remain pinned until retired/drained. L07/current paired consumer and real official startup stay unavailable until corresponding evidence exists.
failure_receipts: failure before publication preserves old active root
copy/start/restart failure after real effects retains those effects in the receipt
new boot mismatch leaves update recovery-required rather than declaring active

ports.name: SessionTransport
required_rules: Reuse the serial byte stream;WebSocket frames/TCP chunks are not protocol packet boundaries. Encoding/profile and original fields stay fixed to their admitted source.
Login candidate/reply timers use their own source phase rules. Local send/write/history is not authenticated login,business acceptance or mail final delivery.

Network disconnect,role transition and Page background are different events;old connection callbacks cannot publish as a new connection. Same-connection source live-bank behavior and a target role guard are separately documented.
failure_receipts: connection errors expose actual stage/known effects
no automatic fabricatedACK,credentials capture or current-profile handoff

ports.name: TextEncodingAndLocalStateStore
required_rules: Source byte limits,NUL/whole-character/normal input domains and native MBCS comparisons remain explicit;Unicode character counts do not replace them.
Source UI edits may commit before an outer dialog cancels. Use each source edit/undo boundary;do not apply global cancel-implies-rollback.
Keep config-directory mapping,character bank,blacklist group,contact slot and actual wire IDs distinct;mail raw caches and source opaque config/album formats are not one serializer.
Do not store credentials/session secrets with resources,telemetry or restart metadata. Field values and private chat are not analysis fixtures.
failure_receipts: unrepresentable/oversize values have explicit outcomes
file/memory copy success,store commit and verified reopen are separate receipts

ports.name: RenderAudioSurfaces
required_rules: Atlas/native layout,logical geometry,glyph/font selection,pixels and actual backend capabilities are evidence-scoped. Do not substitute simplified pixels and call complete native equivalence.
Keep effect/source RNG and audio-maintenance order with the shared pump. Host gesture/background restrictions report blocked until actual behavior is validated.
Logical deletion may leave an admitted animation/render tail;physical surface/buffer retirement follows the lease and drain contract.
failure_receipts: decoder/font/audio/surface failure does not fake animation or round completion
actual phone/WeChat/legacy backend appearance remains required acceptance

ports.name: HostCapabilitiesAndLifecycle
required_rules: Web/mobile-web share the same core;touch/viewport/IME differences are adapters. WeChat App resource roots and Page owners are explicit separate lifetimes.

onHide/visibility loss does not mean process termination or successful persistence. Resume inspects authoritative content/commit,connection identity,inflight work and source-clock policy before reenabling input.

Abrupt host termination cannot rely on a final callback;only previously confirmed commits are recovery candidates. No browser/WeChat fixed quota or device guarantee is inferred from a type declaration.
Capability insufficiency leaves the original target requirement open with a specific receipt;it is not silently redefined as an offline demo or smaller asset domain.
failure_receipts: official WeChat docs unavailable this turn;retain declared-shape/runtime/device distinctions
real host/device/current-official acceptance stays false until its own evidence exists

commit.invariant: Cancellation after pending is a request;only the authoritative backend or inspection determines outcome. committed never becomes cancelled.

snapshot_owner.invariant: An old active reader retains its immutable snapshot until physical drain;replacement never redirects its bytes.

host_lifecycle.invariant: background is not application termination;abrupt termination can bypass every final callback.
